As a Cartridge World employee - BUY A FUCKING LASER PRINTER. Preferably a Brother printer.

HP has been sending out firmware updates to their inkjets to lock consumers out of using aftermarket products. Their 60, 61, 62, 63, and 901's are just outright piles of shit with extremely high failure rates. Their 21, 27, and 56 have cyanoacrylate added to the ink. Bonus points if you know what that is. It fucks the printheads up to where we can't reuse them. Dried up ink on the 22/28/57 causes the film over the printhead to flake off.

Canon 40/41, 210/211, 240/241, and 245/246 are garbage with very high failure rates. Don't buy those.

If you NEED a color inkjet, buy a Brother, or a Canon that takes the PGI250/CLI251 cartridges.

Don't buy an Epson anything unless you HAVE TO.
